name: Transition battle
summary: One player starts at the baseline against a partner at the non-volley-zone line who attacks; the baseline player resets and works forward to the line.
setup: Attacker at the non-volley-zone line; defender at the baseline of the opposite side, in the same half; no lobs
The attacker starts each rally with a feed and then plays live and competitively, driving or speeding up any ball the defender leaves high
The defender resets each ball softly into the non-volley zone and moves forward; the defender wins the rally on reaching the line and winning it there, or on an attacker error
Rounds of 10 rallies; swap roles after each round; the defender tallies rallies lost to their own errors under pressure
success_criterion: In each round of 10 rallies, lose at most 4 rallies to your own errors under pressure
safety_notes: Drives and speed-ups come at the body: wear eye protection, aim low, never at the face, and play no lobs. Stop if in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) Moving forward against an attacker at the line is where amateur players commit the most errors under pressure; a live, competitive version with an error tally trains and measures the AN-07 forced-error share at advanced level. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
